title: 第12章 “新人Tree，登场！”
slug: 什么叫我鲸吞了lpl的气运
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“让我们再次恭喜LGD！”

随着现场主持人的声音，虹桥天地演艺中心的场馆内瞬间被掌声和欢呼声彻底淹没。

因为imp和Marin的缘故，因为去年夏季赛冠军的缘故，这支老干爹还是有不少粉丝。

在LGD春季赛1胜8负、已经快要跌入保级泥潭的惨淡背景下，支持者们本来都已经绝望了。

毕竟这是一支在春季赛只战胜过EPA的队伍。

二比零。

赛前无论是电竞媒体还是贴吧暴躁老哥，压根没有一个人料到会是这个结局。

普通观众今天买票到现场，纯粹是抱着看乐子的审判心态来的。

他们想看看这艘银河战舰还能沉得有多难看，新人又会打出怎样滑稽的操作。

同队的Eimy就表演过新人首秀以失败告终的戏码。

Eimy好歹还打过LPL，Tree是纯新人。

可谁能想到，笑着笑着，LGD这回居然真把骨灰给扬了。

而且两盘比赛加起来不到一个小时，赢得干脆利落。

舞台上方巨大的摇臂镜头不断在观众席上扫过，此时官方直播间的弹幕池早已被各种颜色的感叹号塞满：

“Tree确实打的不错”

“LGD管理层捡到宝了”

“这泰坦比tank的泰坦存在感强太多了。”

后台休息室里，门被一把推开，现场执行工作人员快步走了进来，目光直接锁定了正坐在椅子上休息的年轻人：“Tree，别卸妆，大荧幕采访准备一下，该你上场了。”

陈周早已做好了准备，新人登场接受采访是惯例。

旁边的Eimy听到声音，反倒比这位当事人还要激动，整个人腾地一下从沙发上弹了起来，大呼小叫地揽住陈周的肩膀：“卧槽！陈哥！采访啊！首秀直接拿赛后采访！第一次啊兄弟！！”

imp则是有些轻佻地挑了挑眉毛，操着一口不太流利的中文笑骂道：“阿西……别紧张啊Tree，等会儿台上有漂亮主持人的，上去别说太多没用废话就行。”

MaRin虽然听不懂队内的中文交流，但看到工作人员的动作和众人的反应，也立刻心领神会发生了什么。

这位平日里不苟言笑的世界冠军隔着长桌，用好奇的眼光看了看陈周，似乎在期待着他接受采访。

陈周放下水杯，整理了一下LGD的红白队服，顺着工作人员指引，不紧不慢地朝着采访区走去。

走出通道的那一刹那，虹桥天地灯光当头砸下。

强烈的眩光让陈周下意识微眯起了双眼。

“Tree！！”

“Tree！！！”

现场观众的声音隔着耳返，一阵一阵传进来。

其实并不算特别整齐。

有人喊LGD，有人喊Tree，还有人在激动地讨论刚才那波反蹲和四包二。

可就是这些混杂在一起的声音，让陈周忽然有点恍惚。

因为这个ID，原本只存在于他的记忆里，或者更准确一点，只属于他自己。

Tree。

木已成舟。

活着的木头叫Tree。

死掉的木头叫Wood。

这是他当年第一次注册韩服账号时起的名字。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Let us congratulate LGD again!"

Following the voice of the live host, the venue of Hongqiao Tiandi Performing Arts Center was instantly overwhelmed by applause and cheers.

Because of imp and Marin, and because of last year's summer split championship, this team still has many fans.

Against the bleak background of LGD's 1 win and 8 losses in the Spring Split and almost falling into the quagmire of relegation, supporters were already desperate.

After all, this is a team that has only defeated EPA in the spring split.

Two to zero.

Before the game, no one, whether it was the e-sports media or the grumpy old man on Tieba, expected this ending.

Ordinary spectators bought tickets and came to the venue today purely with a judgmental mentality of having fun.

They want to see how ugly this galactic battleship can sink, and what kind of funny operations the newcomers can perform.

Eimy, who is on the same team, once performed a scene where the debut of a rookie ended in failure.

Eimy has played in the LPL after all, and Tree is a complete newcomer.

But who would have thought, with a smile, LGD would actually spread the ashes this time.

Moreover, the two sets took less than an hour in total, and the victory was clean and tidy.

The huge crane camera above the stage kept scanning the audience. At this time, the barrage pool in the official live broadcast room was already filled with exclamation marks of various colors:

“Tree did really well”

“LGD management found a treasure”

"This Titan has a much stronger sense of presence than the tank's Titan."

In the backstage lounge, the door was pushed open, and the on-site executive walked in quickly. His eyes were directly locked on the young man who was sitting on the chair and resting: "Tree, don't take off your makeup. Get ready for the big screen interview. It's your turn."

Chen Zhou has already made preparations. It is customary for newcomers to appear for interviews.

When Eimy next to her heard the voice, she was even more excited than the person involved. She jumped up from the sofa and threw her arms around Chen Zhou's shoulders while shouting: "F*ck! Brother Chen! This is an interview! It's my first show and I have a post-match interview! It's my first time, brother!!"

The imp raised his eyebrows frivolously, and said with a smile in not very fluent Chinese: "Axi... don't be nervous, Tree, there will be a beautiful host on the stage later, just don't talk too much useless nonsense."

Although MaRin couldn't understand the Chinese communication in the team, she immediately understood what was happening when she saw the actions of the staff and everyone's reactions.

The normally unsmiling world champion looked at Chen Zhou with curiosity across the long table, as if expecting him to be interviewed.

Chen Zhou put down his water glass, adjusted LGD's red and white uniforms, followed the staff's guidance, and walked slowly towards the interview area.

The moment he walked out of the passage, the lights from Hongqiao Heaven and Earth hit his head.

The strong glare made Chen Zhou subconsciously narrow his eyes.

"Tree!!"

"Tree!!!"

The voices of the audience came in one after another through the ears.

It's not particularly tidy actually.

Some people shouted LGD, some people called Tree, and some people were excitedly discussing the reverse squat and four-pack-two just now.

But it was these mixed sounds that made Chen Zhou suddenly feel a little dazed.

Because this ID originally only existed in his memory, or to be more precise, it only belonged to him.

Tree.

The wood has become a boat.

Living wood is called Tree.

Dead wood is called Wood.

This was the name he gave when he first registered a Korean server account.
